title: 1. Archive tab
description: Open your Soul Archive to find the Essence you just absorbed.

title: 2. Soul Archive
description: Absorbed Essences appear in your Soul Archive.

title: 3. Active loadout
description: Essences in your active loadout provide their abilities during combat. Changes remain a draft until you save them.

title: 5. Save your loadout
description: Your draft has unsaved changes. Save the loadout to attune the Essence and make its abilities available in combat.
